newsitem.title: UK: Lonrho board ends meeting, no statement.
newsitem.headline: Lonrho board ends meeting, no statement.

text.p: Lonrho Plc said it did not plan to release a statement on the outcome of Tuesday's board meeting on merger proposals from South Africa's JCI Ltd.
"We have nothing to add to last week's statement which confirmed we are in preliminary talks about the financial benefits of a possible combination," a spokesman said.
Newspapers here reported that Lonrho wants a 60 percent stake in any new entity. JCI, however, is believed to have in mind a Lonrho interest of only just over 50 percent.
A merger between Lonrho and JCI would create one the world's biggest mining houses, with a market capitalisation of about three billion dollars.
Besides JCI -- South Africa's sixth largest mining firm --, Avmin Ltd and Gencor Ltd from the same country were also interested in a tie-up with Lonrho, a South African newspaper reported last week.
